curiosities: It was one of the first computers sold with a CD-ROM drive as standard, in 1989.
It was named after Charles Townes, the Nobel-winning laser physicist.
The FM Towns Marty of 1993 turned it into a games console.
It starts from a CD, with no floppy disk needed.
It got close ports of arcade games such as After Burner.
bestsellers: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis
